register.labelZh: LEAD 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: lead into 可以描述問題、故事或活動如何自然帶入下一部分。；lead off 和 lead off with 可以說明誰先開始,以及以甚麼內容開始。；lead off 和 lead off from 可以描述從另一條道路或某個地點岔出的街道、小徑和通道。；lead somebody on 可以描述誤導他人;lead up to 則可以解釋重要事情發生前的事件或時期。
register.summaryEn: Lead into helps you describe how a question, story or activity naturally introduces the next part. Lead off and lead off with help you say who begins and what they use to begin. Lead off and lead off from can describe streets, paths and passages that leave another road or place. Lead somebody on describes misleading someone. Lead up to helps explain the events or period before something important happens.

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；使用 lead somebody on 時,把表示人物的字放在 lead 和 on 之間。；請仔細閱讀情境:lead off 可以表示「帶頭開始」,也可以表示道路或小徑「從某處岔出」。lead into 表示自然帶入下一個話題或活動;lead up to 則描述某事發生前的時間或事件。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. In lead somebody on, place the person between lead and on: lead him on lead the customers on Read the situation carefully: lead off can mean “start first”, but a road or path can also lead off another road or place. lead into introduces the next topic or activity, while lead up to describes the time or events before something happens.
